summary: If custom settings (CA certs, OAuth, RBAC) disappear after upgrade, the values file wasn't passed: export with helm get values > current-values.yaml, upgrade with -f current-values.yaml, then check helm get values.
questions: Portal custom values lost after helm upgrade
How do I keep my portal settings during upgrade?
Custom CA missing after portal upgrade

answer_card.title: Keep custom values across portal upgrades
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
helm get values <release_name> -n <namespace> > current-values.yaml
helm upgrade <release_name> openshift-helm-charts/redhat-rhaap-portal \
  --version <target_version> -f current-values.yaml -n <namespace>
helm get values <release_name> -n <namespace>   # confirm
```
